text: This run evaluated the voice-agents page for business owners in banks and lenders who want more visitors to start building. In the hero (saved copy from 2026-11-15), questions A3-proof and A4-cta failed because the hero does not do those jobs yet. The writer created variant A to emphasize speed, variant B for compliance proof, and variant C for tool-connected calls. Jev and Judge 2 held variants A and C because both beat the hero on the targeted gaps, but had a flagged phrase. Variant B was a near miss and failed Gate 2 because scores on other questions fell. A person edited variant A into A-edit1, and the judges held this edit as well.
